scope: Full portable materialization harness through Oops with TCC resource metrics, capture inspection/receiver compatibility and generated admission refusal

regression_before.failure: Capture inspection raised a native failure for the uncoded Block prototype instead of nil.

pre_oop_baseline.scope: Full original harness, with fixture-path adjustments only.

owner_changes: Execution restores nil for unavailable capture inspection and invalid indices, with no foreign payload reads.
Block captureWord:of: is restored as the synchronous compiler owner entry; valid targets use their current captureWordAt: reader.
Resumable entry validates required Execution-owned capture storage before reading it.
Generated initialization returns immediately when CodeObject admission answers nil.
retained_checks: Canonical code identity, distinct CodeObjects sharing materializations, source Block replacement and independent captures.
Both dispositions: exact floating bits and binary Strings, lexical lets, nested captures and original capture-read timing around compilation.
Native mismatch failure and language Error conversion are checked at their respective callers; synchronous mismatched receivers return nil.
Marked native failures and ordinary Error data in captures remain distinct.
Collecting dependency replacements remain live, including the restored owner reader.
Failed admission/Block construction publishes no cache entry and releases its native Unit.
The 64-entry LRU count and eviction order are unchanged.
Suspension survives cache eviction; synchronous native boundaries reject parking.
Source and materialized Methods retain code through aliases, with exact native-byte retirement after final removal.
Nested Block clones retain their shared mutable capture and code after every cache is evicted.

rejected_experiment.description: A temporary result-conversion continuation on generic explicit invocation changed native control failures in recovery. It was removed entirely. Native Oop invocation remains raw; actual language callers supply Error conversion.

scope_limit: The full materialization harness is now migrated. Other native/compiler harnesses and fresh latest-runtime cold installation/Host qualification remain pending. Resource-metrics TCC is confined to this staged test prefix.
